prompt:
Fix snippets/preorder-notice-3.liquid so that it always renders a pre-order notice with sensible fallback text. Inputs (both top-level variables, both always supplied): - `label`: string or null. The notice heading. - `ship_date`: string or null. Free-text shipping estimate. Rules: - Remove leading and trailing whitespace from `label`. If the result is empty, or `label` is null, use exactly `Pre-order` instead. - Remove leading and trailing whitespace from `ship_date`. If the result is empty, or `ship_date` is null, use exactly `soon` instead. - HTML-escape both final values, after the fallback has been applied. Output is always exactly this single line, with no other text: `

{label} Ships {ship_date}

` There is exactly one space between `` and ``, and one space after `Ships`. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/preorder-notice-3.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
